title: Weights CSV with a byte-exact header and 6-decimal rounding
source:
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
pos = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/positions.csv")
w = pos["mktval"].to_numpy(float) / pos["mktval"].sum()
micro = np.round(w * 1e6).astype(np.int64)
if abs(micro.sum() - 1_000_000) > 5:
    # Largest-remainder correction only if plain rounding breaks the 5e-6 sum rule.
    floor = np.floor(w * 1e6).astype(np.int64)
    short = 1_000_000 - floor.sum()
    order = np.argsort(-(w * 1e6 - floor), kind="stable")
    floor[order[:short]] += 1
    micro = floor
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
with open("/app/output/weights.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
    fh.write("asset,weight\n")
    for a, m in zip(pos["asset"], micro):
        fh.write(f"{a},{m / 1e6:.6f}\n")
